sentences.text: Es temprano en el pueblo.
sentences.english: It is early in the village.

sentences.text: Un autobús llega al templo con la brigada médica.
sentences.english: A bus arrives at the church with the medical brigade.

sentences.text: Ana viene en la brigada, con Karla, Luis y cinco enfermeras y médicos.
sentences.english: Ana comes with the brigade, along with Karla, Luis and five nurses and doctors.

sentences.text: Traen cajas con vacunas, pastillas y jabón.
sentences.english: They bring boxes with vaccines, pills and soap.

sentences.text: El pastor Andrés les da la bienvenida.
sentences.english: Pastor Andrés welcomes them.

sentences.text: Abraza a Ana y saluda a todos.
sentences.english: He hugs Ana and greets everyone.

sentences.text: La noticia de la brigada llegó hace una semana, y muchos llegaron temprano.
sentences.english: The news of the brigade arrived a week ago, and many came early.

sentences.text: Después del huracán, muchas familias escaparon del agua y hoy viven en casas pequeñas.
sentences.english: After the hurricane, many families escaped the water and today they live in small houses.

sentences.text: Hay enfermedades en el pueblo, y por eso vienen hoy los médicos.
sentences.english: There are illnesses in the village, and that is why the doctors are coming today.

sentences.text: El templo es hoy una clínica pequeña.
sentences.english: The church is a small clinic today.

sentences.text: Hay una mesa para los nombres y otra para los niños.
sentences.english: There is one table for names and another for the children.

sentences.text: Karla escribe el nombre y la edad de todos.
sentences.english: Karla writes down everyone's name and age.

sentences.text: Kevin, del colegio, la ayuda.
sentences.english: Kevin, from the high school, helps her.

sentences.text: Los alumnos de Luis traen agua.
sentences.english: Luis's students bring water.

sentences.text: Es una lección de salud para ellos.
sentences.english: It is a health lesson for them.

sentences.text: —Esta clase es mejor que un libro —dice Luis.
sentences.english: "This class is better than a book," says Luis.

sentences.text: La gente espera sentada en el patio.
sentences.english: The people wait seated in the patio.

sentences.text: Hay niños, mamás y viejos.
sentences.english: There are children, moms and old people.

sentences.text: Una mamá llega con su hijo Diego.
sentences.english: A mom arrives with her son Diego.

sentences.text: —Diego se cayó ayer —dice—.
sentences.english: "Diego fell yesterday," she says.

sentences.text: Tiene una herida en la rodilla.
sentences.english: "He has a wound on his knee."

sentences.text: —Vení, Diego.
sentences.english: "Come, Diego.

sentences.text: Sentate aquí —dice Ana.
sentences.english: Sit here," says Ana.

sentences.text: Ana mira la herida.
sentences.english: Ana looks at the wound.

sentences.text: —¿Tenías fiebre ayer? —le pregunta a Diego.
sentences.english: "Did you have a fever yesterday?" she asks Diego.

sentences.text: —No, pero me dolía mucho, y lloraba.
sentences.english: "No, but it hurt a lot, and I was crying."

sentences.text: Ana trata la herida con agua limpia y jabón.
sentences.english: Ana treats the wound with clean water and soap.

sentences.text: Diego ya no llora.
sentences.english: Diego is not crying anymore.

sentences.text: —Señora, dele mucha agua y cuídelo en la casa —dice Ana.
sentences.english: "Ma'am, give him lots of water and take care of him at home," says Ana.

sentences.text: —Va a sanar en una semana.
sentences.english: "It will heal in a week.

sentences.text: Póngale esta crema en la mañana y en la noche.
sentences.english: Put this cream on it in the morning and at night."

sentences.text: El señor Rafael llega con la mano roja.
sentences.english: Señor Rafael arrives with a red hand.

sentences.text: Se quemó con aceite ayer por la tarde.
sentences.english: He burned himself with oil yesterday afternoon.

sentences.text: —Fue un accidente —dice—.
sentences.english: "It was an accident," he says.

sentences.text: Estaba cocinando, y el aceite cayó en mi dedo.
sentences.english: "I was cooking, and the oil fell on my finger."

sentences.text: Ana mira la piel.
sentences.english: Ana looks at the skin.

sentences.text: La piel está roja, y se rompió una uña.
sentences.english: The skin is red, and a nail broke.

sentences.text: —No se ponga nada en la piel.
sentences.english: "Do not put anything on the skin.

sentences.text: Ponga el dedo en agua fría —dice Ana.
sentences.english: Put your finger in cold water," says Ana.

sentences.text: —Cuando se quema la piel, se trata con agua fría.
sentences.english: "When skin is burned, it is treated with cold water.

sentences.text: La uña va a crecer de nuevo.
sentences.english: The nail will grow back."

sentences.text: —No quiero quemarme de nuevo —dice el señor Rafael.
sentences.english: "I do not want to burn myself again," says Señor Rafael.

sentences.text: —Hoy empieza a sanar, pero va a doler un poco.
sentences.english: "Today it begins to heal, but it is going to hurt a little."

sentences.text: Karla pone crema en el dedo del señor Rafael.
sentences.english: Karla puts cream on Señor Rafael's finger.

sentences.text: —Compre más crema en la farmacia —dice.
sentences.english: "Buy more cream at the pharmacy," she says.

sentences.text: Una mamá trae a su hija.
sentences.english: A mother brings her daughter.

sentences.text: —Mi hija tenía fiebre hace tres días.
sentences.english: "My daughter had a fever three days ago.

sentences.text: Le dolían los huesos y la cabeza.
sentences.english: Her bones and head hurt."

sentences.text: —Abra la boca, por favor.
sentences.english: "Open your mouth, please.

sentences.text: Muéstreme la lengua —dice Ana.
sentences.english: Show me your tongue," says Ana.

sentences.text: Ana mira la lengua de la niña.
sentences.english: Ana looks at the girl's tongue.

sentences.text: —La lengua está bien, pero la fiebre es alta.
sentences.english: "The tongue is fine, but the fever is high.

sentences.text: Puede ser dengue —dice—.
sentences.english: It could be dengue," she says.

sentences.text: El dengue viene de un insecto pequeño.
sentences.english: "Dengue comes from a small insect."

sentences.text: —¿Es una enfermedad grande? —pregunta la mamá.
sentences.english: "Is it a serious illness?" asks the mother.

sentences.text: —Es una enfermedad, pero se trata.
sentences.english: "It is an illness, but it can be treated.

sentences.text: Llévela a la clínica del pueblo y quédese con ella.
sentences.english: Take her to the clinic in the village and stay with her."

sentences.text: Karla le da una pastilla para la fiebre.
sentences.english: Karla gives her a pill for the fever.

sentences.text: La mamá agradece a Ana con un abrazo.
sentences.english: The mother thanks Ana with a hug.

sentences.text: Al mediodía, Ana habla a todos en el templo.
sentences.english: At noon, Ana speaks to everyone in the church.

sentences.text: —Los insectos viven en el agua que no se usa.
sentences.english: "Insects live in water that is not used.

sentences.text: Cambien el agua cada día.
sentences.english: Change the water every day."

sentences.text: —Las moscas están en la comida y traen enfermedades.
sentences.english: "Flies are on the food and bring illnesses.

sentences.text: Muchos niños se enferman cuando el agua no es limpia.
sentences.english: Many children get sick when the water is not clean.

sentences.text: Si un niño se enferma, avísenme.
sentences.english: If a child gets sick, let me know.

sentences.text: Con agua limpia, las heridas sanan mejor.
sentences.english: With clean water, wounds heal better."

sentences.text: —Cuando hay dengue, el niño sufre.
sentences.english: "When there is dengue, the child suffers.

sentences.text: Le duelen los huesos.
sentences.english: His bones hurt.

sentences.text: Vayan a la clínica.
sentences.english: Go to the clinic."

sentences.text: —No quiero enfermarme —dice un niño—.
sentences.english: "I don't want to get sick," says a boy.

sentences.text: Karla le muestra la lengua, y los niños también muestran la lengua.
sentences.english: Karla sticks out her tongue at him, and the children stick out their tongues too.

sentences.text: —Báñense con jabón todos los días, en la ducha o con agua, y usen una toalla limpia.
sentences.english: "Bathe with soap every day, in the shower or with water, and use a clean towel.

sentences.text: Cepillen el pelo de los niños.
sentences.english: Brush the children's hair."

sentences.text: —Los niños deben acostarse temprano.
sentences.english: "The children should go to bed early.

sentences.text: Despiértenlos con una canción, levántenlos y vístanlos.
sentences.english: Wake them with a song, get them up and dress them."

sentences.text: Luis dice a sus alumnos: —Miren su cara en el espejo.
sentences.english: Luis says to his students, "Look at your face in the mirror.

sentences.text: ¿Está limpia?
sentences.english: Is it clean?

sentences.text: ¿Y el pelo?
sentences.english: And your hair?

sentences.text: Ahora, la lección del cuerpo: el cuello, el hombro, el dedo, la uña, la rodilla.
sentences.english: Now, the lesson on the body: the neck, the shoulder, the finger, the nail, the knee.

sentences.text: Un hueso se puede romper en un accidente.
sentences.english: A bone can break in an accident."

sentences.text: —Esta es la tarea: hablen con su familia sobre lo que oyeron hoy.
sentences.english: "This is the homework: talk with your family about what you heard today."

sentences.text: Después, los niños van a la mesa de la vacuna.
sentences.english: Afterwards, the children go to the vaccine table.

sentences.text: Karla la pone en el hombro de cada niño.
sentences.english: Karla gives it in each child's shoulder.

sentences.text: Una niña llora.
sentences.english: A girl cries.

sentences.text: Su mamá la abraza y le da un beso.
sentences.english: Her mom hugs her and gives her a kiss.

sentences.text: —No duele mucho —dice Karla—.
sentences.english: "It does not hurt much," says Karla.

sentences.text: Después de la vacuna, viene el pan.
sentences.english: "After the vaccine, comes the bread.

sentences.text: Cuiden el pan por las moscas.
sentences.english: Take care of the bread because of the flies."

sentences.text: Los niños sufren un momento, pero luego están contentos.
sentences.english: The children suffer for a moment, but then they are happy.

sentences.text: Ana y Karla tratan a mucha gente, y hoy hay muchos insectos y moscas en el templo.
sentences.english: Ana and Karla treat a lot of people, and today there are many insects and flies in the church.

sentences.text: Una abuela llega con dolor en el cuello y en el hombro.
sentences.english: A grandmother arrives with pain in her neck and shoulder.

sentences.text: —¿Sufre mucho? —pregunta Ana.
sentences.english: "Do you suffer a lot?" asks Ana.

sentences.text: —Sí, sufro mucho.
sentences.english: "Yes, I suffer a lot.

sentences.text: Llevo el agua lejos cada día.
sentences.english: I carry water far every day.

sentences.text: Me duele el cuello, y me duele la rodilla.
sentences.english: My neck hurts, and my knee hurts."

sentences.text: —Siéntese.
sentences.english: "Sit down.

sentences.text: No lleve mucha agua.
sentences.english: Do not carry so much water.

sentences.text: Que sus nietos la ayuden.
sentences.english: Let your grandchildren help you."

sentences.text: Ana da una receta.
sentences.english: Ana gives a prescription.

sentences.text: —En la farmacia del pueblo venden estas pastillas.
sentences.english: "In the village pharmacy they sell these pills.

sentences.text: La farmacia está lejos, pero hoy tenemos pastillas.
sentences.english: The pharmacy is far, but today we have pills."

sentences.text: Entonces una abeja llega al templo.
sentences.english: Then a bee comes into the church.

sentences.text: Los niños gritan, y muchos escapan.
sentences.english: The children shout, and many run away.

sentences.text: —No pasa nada —dice Luis—.
sentences.english: "It's all right," says Luis.

sentences.text: La abeja es amiga de las flores.
sentences.english: "The bee is a friend of the flowers."

sentences.text: La abeja se va, y todos están contentos.
sentences.english: The bee leaves, and everyone is happy.

sentences.text: Por la tarde, la congregación se reúne en el templo para dar gracias.
sentences.english: In the afternoon, the congregation gathers in the church to give thanks.

sentences.text: Hoy el pastor no predica.
sentences.english: Today the pastor does not preach.

sentences.text: Lee un versículo del capítulo diez, y todos oran.
sentences.english: He reads a verse from chapter ten, and everyone prays.

sentences.text: Una mamá da su testimonio: —Hoy mi hija tiene ayuda, y yo estoy feliz.
sentences.english: A mother gives her testimony: "Today my daughter has help, and I am happy."

sentences.text: El diezmo de la congregación ayudó a comprar las pastillas.
sentences.english: The congregation's tithe helped buy the pills.

sentences.text: El domingo, el pastor va a bautizar a tres creyentes.
sentences.english: On Sunday, the pastor is going to baptize three believers.

sentences.text: El bautismo es una fiesta.
sentences.english: Baptism is a celebration.

sentences.text: Ana, Karla y Luis se despiden de la gente con abrazos y besos.
sentences.english: Ana, Karla and Luis say goodbye to the people with hugs and kisses.

sentences.text: Muchos asisten a la despedida.
sentences.english: Many attend the farewell.

sentences.text: El pastor los acompaña hasta el autobús.
sentences.english: The pastor accompanies them to the bus.

sentences.text: —Vuelvan en septiembre —dice.
sentences.english: "Come back in September," he says.
